sname: 家族・恋人・友人のけんか
title: けんか・仲直りのくだけた表現

items.en: Hey, Maya, I need you to hear me out before you explain.
items.jp: ねえマヤ、説明する前に最後まで聞いてほしい。
items.speak: Hey, Maya, I need you to hear me out before you explain.

items.en: Babe, I said I'd be there, and I should've called when I knew I was late.
items.jp: ねえ、行くって言ったんだから、遅れると分かった時点で電話すべきだった。
items.speak: Babe, I said I'd be there, and I should've called when I knew I was late.

items.en: Look, I'm not mad about the dishes. I'm mad that you waited for me to ask.
items.jp: 食器のことで怒ってるんじゃないよ。私が頼むまで待ってたことに腹が立ってるの。
items.speak: Look, I'm not mad about the dishes. I'm mad that you waited for me to ask.

items.en: Dude, that joke hit a nerve. Can we not do that in front of everyone?
items.jp: ねえ、その冗談は傷ついたよ。みんなの前でそういうこと言うのはやめてくれる？
items.speak: Dude, that joke hit a nerve. Can we not do that in front of everyone?

items.en: I didn't mean it like that, but I can see why it came out hurtful.
items.jp: そんなつもりじゃなかったけど、傷つく言い方だったのは分かる。
items.speak: I didn't mean it like that, but I can see why it came out hurtful.

items.en: Hey, Dad, please ask before you share my news with the whole family.
items.jp: ねえお父さん、私の近況を家族みんなに話す前に聞いてね。
items.speak: Hey, Dad, please ask before you share my news with the whole family.

items.en: I'm sorry, okay? I got defensive because I knew I messed up.
items.jp: ごめんって。失敗したのが分かってたから、つい身構えちゃった。
items.speak: I'm sorry, okay? I got defensive because I knew I messed up.

items.en: Jen, you don't have to fix this tonight. Just tell me what you need.
items.jp: ジェン、今夜中に解決しなくていいよ。何が必要か教えて。
items.speak: Jen, you don't have to fix this tonight. Just tell me what you need.

items.en: I need a minute before I say something I'll regret.
items.jp: 後悔することを言う前に、少し時間がほしい。
items.speak: I need a minute before I say something I'll regret.

items.en: C'mon, Alex. Don't turn one bad evening into a verdict on us.
items.jp: お願い、アレックス。今夜うまくいかなかっただけで、二人の関係まで決めつけないで。
items.speak: C'mon, Alex. Don't turn one bad evening into a verdict on us.
items.note: 元の形: come on／聞こえ方: カモン／使う場面:親しい相手をなだめる

items.en: I know you're upset, but yelling isn't getting us anywhere.
items.jp: 怒ってるのは分かるけど、怒鳴っても何も進まないよ。
items.speak: I know you're upset, but yelling isn't getting us anywhere.

items.en: Maya, I was gonna text you. Then I kept putting it off, which wasn't fair.
items.jp: マヤ、連絡しようと思ってた。でも後回しにし続けた。そんなの不公平だったね。
items.speak: Maya, I was gonna text you. Then I kept putting it off, which wasn't fair.
items.note: 元の形: going to／聞こえ方: ガナ／使う場面:予定や意図を打ち明ける

items.en: Can we start over? I don't wanna win this; I wanna understand you.
items.jp: やり直せるかな。言い負かしたいんじゃなくて、あなたを分かりたい。
items.speak: Can we start over? I don't wanna win this; I wanna understand you.
items.note: 元の形: want to／聞こえ方: ワナ／使う場面:仲直りを提案する

items.en: You good? You went quiet after I brought up your sister.
items.jp: 大丈夫？妹さんの話を出してから黙っちゃったね。
items.speak: You good? You went quiet after I brought up your sister.
items.note: 元の形: are you good／聞こえ方: ユーグッ／使う場面:親しい相手を気遣う

items.en: No, I'm not good. I told you that was private.
items.jp: いや、大丈夫じゃないよ。内緒だって言ったでしょ。
items.speak: No, I'm not good. I told you that was private.

items.en: Hey, Mom, I'm not asking you to agree. Just don't decide for me.
items.jp: ねえお母さん、賛成してほしいわけじゃないよ。私の代わりに決めないで。
items.speak: Hey, Mom, I'm not asking you to agree. Just don't decide for me.

items.en: I hear you. I just need a second to let that sink in.
items.jp: 言いたいことは分かった。少し考えさせて。
items.speak: I hear you. I just need a second to let that sink in.

items.en: Sam, you can't say "relax" and expect me to magically relax.
items.jp: サム、「落ち着いて」って言えば私が急に落ち着くと思わないで。
items.speak: Sam, you can't say "relax" and expect me to magically relax.

items.en: Fair. That came out patronizing. Let me try again.
items.jp: 確かに。上から目線に聞こえたね。言い直させて。
items.speak: Fair. That came out patronizing. Let me try again.

items.en: I'm not saying you never help. I'm saying I can't keep reminding you.
items.jp: 手伝ってくれないと言ってるんじゃないよ。何度も催促するのはもう無理ってこと。
items.speak: I'm not saying you never help. I'm saying I can't keep reminding you.

items.en: Hey, babe, I know I promised, and I don't have a good excuse.
items.jp: ねえ、ごめん。約束したのは分かってるし、いい言い訳もないよ。
items.speak: Hey, babe, I know I promised, and I don't have a good excuse.

items.en: I get why you're mad. I would've felt brushed off too.
items.jp: 怒るのも分かるよ。私だって軽くあしらわれたと感じたと思う。
items.speak: I get why you're mad. I would've felt brushed off too.

items.en: Wait, what? You told them before you asked me?
items.jp: え、何だって？私に聞く前にみんなに話したの？
items.speak: Wait, what? You told them before you asked me?

items.en: I was gonna tell you. I just didn't know how to bring it up.
items.jp: 話すつもりだったんだ。どう切り出せばいいか分からなかった。
items.speak: I was gonna tell you. I just didn't know how to bring it up.
items.note: 元の形: going to／聞こえ方: ワズガナ／使う場面:言い出せなかった事情を話す

items.en: Liz, please don't make me guess whether we're okay.
items.jp: リズ、私たちが大丈夫なのか、察しなきゃいけない状態にしないで。
items.speak: Liz, please don't make me guess whether we're okay.

items.en: I'm not ready to talk, but I'm not walking away from us.
items.jp: まだ話す準備はできてない。でも、二人の関係を投げ出すつもりはないよ。
items.speak: I'm not ready to talk, but I'm not walking away from us.

items.en: Dude, you keep saying "I'm fine" like I can't hear your voice shaking.
items.jp: ねえ、「平気」って繰り返してるけど、声が震えてるのは分かるよ。
items.speak: Dude, you keep saying "I'm fine" like I can't hear your voice shaking.

items.en: I'm kinda overwhelmed. Can we talk after I get some air?
items.jp: ちょっといっぱいいっぱい。外の空気を吸ってから話せる？
items.speak: I'm kinda overwhelmed. Can we talk after I get some air?
items.note: 元の形: kind of／聞こえ方: カインダ／使う場面:控えめに状態を伝える

items.en: Take your time. I'll be here when you're ready.
items.jp: ゆっくりでいいよ。話せるようになったらここにいるから。
items.speak: Take your time. I'll be here when you're ready.

items.en: Hey, Chris, don't joke about that. I told you it was a sore spot.
items.jp: ねえクリス、それを冗談にしないで。気にしてるって話したよね。
items.speak: Hey, Chris, don't joke about that. I told you it was a sore spot.

items.en: You're right. I shouldn't have brought it up, especially in front of them.
items.jp: その通りだね。話題にすべきじゃなかった。特にみんなの前では。
items.speak: You're right. I shouldn't have brought it up, especially in front of them.

items.en: I'm not keeping score. I'm telling you this has happened a lot.
items.jp: 点数をつけてるんじゃないよ。何度も同じことがあったと伝えてるの。
items.speak: I'm not keeping score. I'm telling you this has happened a lot.

items.en: How am I supposed to trust that if nothing changes?
items.jp: 何も変わらないのに、どうやって信じればいいの？
items.speak: How am I supposed to trust that if nothing changes?

items.en: I don't know yet. I gotta show you, not just say it.
items.jp: まだ分からない。口で言うだけじゃなく、行動で示さなきゃ。
items.speak: I don't know yet. I gotta show you, not just say it.
items.note: 元の形: have got to／聞こえ方: ガラ／使う場面:必要な行動を認める

items.en: Hey, sis, I love you, but I can't lend you money again.
items.jp: ねえ、お姉ちゃん。大好きだけど、もうお金は貸せないよ。
items.speak: Hey, sis, I love you, but I can't lend you money again.

items.en: I wasn't asking you to fix it. I just wanted you on my side.
items.jp: 解決してほしかったわけじゃない。ただ味方でいてほしかった。
items.speak: I wasn't asking you to fix it. I just wanted you on my side.

items.en: Babe, can we pause this and come back when we're both calmer?
items.jp: ねえ、いったん止めて、お互い落ち着いてから話し直せる？
items.speak: Babe, can we pause this and come back when we're both calmer?

items.en: Yeah, but let's pick a time. I don't want this to disappear.
items.jp: いいよ。でも時間を決めよう。うやむやにはしたくない。
items.speak: Yeah, but let's pick a time. I don't want this to disappear.

items.en: I'm sorry I snapped. I was scared, and I took it out on you.
items.jp: きつく当たってごめん。怖くて、あなたにぶつけてしまった。
items.speak: I'm sorry I snapped. I was scared, and I took it out on you.

items.en: I can forgive you and still need a little space tonight.
items.jp: 許すことはできるよ。それでも今夜は少し距離を置きたい。
items.speak: I can forgive you and still need a little space tonight.

items.en: Hey, buddy, I wasn't trying to embarrass you. I read the room wrong.
items.jp: ねえ、恥をかかせるつもりはなかったんだ。場の空気を読み違えた。
items.speak: Hey, buddy, I wasn't trying to embarrass you. I read the room wrong.

items.en: I dunno what you want me to say, but I know I hurt you.
items.jp: 何て言えばいいか分からない。でも傷つけたのは分かってる。
items.speak: I dunno what you want me to say, but I know I hurt you.
items.note: 元の形: do not know／聞こえ方: ダノウ／使う場面:言葉に詰まったとき

items.en: That's not an apology if you add "but" right after it.
items.jp: 謝った直後に「でも」を付けたら、謝罪にならないよ。
items.speak: That's not an apology if you add "but" right after it.

items.en: You're right. I'm sorry. No excuse, no "but."
items.jp: その通り。ごめん。言い訳も「でも」もなし。
items.speak: You're right. I'm sorry. No excuse, no "but."

items.en: Man, I miss when we could disagree without making it personal.
items.jp: ねえ、意見が違っても個人攻撃にならなかった頃が懐かしいよ。
items.speak: Man, I miss when we could disagree without making it personal.

items.en: We can get back there, but we both gotta stop trying to land the last word.
items.jp: またそうなれるよ。でも二人とも最後に言い返そうとするのはやめないと。
items.speak: We can get back there, but we both gotta stop trying to land the last word.
items.note: 元の形: have got to／聞こえ方: ガラ／使う場面:必要な変化を提案する

items.en: Nora, say it like a human. Are you upset with me or just tired?
items.jp: ノラ、普通に言ってよ。私に怒ってるの、それとも疲れてるだけ？
items.speak: Nora, say it like a human. Are you upset with me or just tired?

items.en: I'm upset, and I'm tired. Both things can be true.
items.jp: 怒ってるし、疲れてもいるよ。両方あり得るでしょ。
items.speak: I'm upset, and I'm tired. Both things can be true.

items.en: C'mon, let's not drag three old arguments into this one.
items.jp: お願いだから、昔のけんかを3つも今回に持ち込まないで。
items.speak: C'mon, let's not drag three old arguments into this one.
items.note: 元の形: come on／聞こえ方: カモン／使う場面:話を今の問題に戻す

items.en: Okay. One thing at a time. Tell me what hurt the most.
items.jp: 分かった。一つずつ話そう。何が一番つらかったか教えて。
items.speak: Okay. One thing at a time. Tell me what hurt the most.
